title: Regular transition maps between semilocal principal-adic completions
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $x\in A$. Suppose $A/xA$ is a G-ring [def-weil-pbc-g-ring]. For every nonempty finite set $\gamma$ of maximal ideals of $A$ containing $x$, put $S_\gamma=A\setminus\bigcup_{\mathfrak m\in\gamma}\mathfrak m$, $A_\gamma=S_\gamma^{-1}A$ (fractions $a/s$), and $D_\gamma=\varprojlim_{j\ge1}A_\gamma/x^jA_\gamma$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then $D_\gamma$ is a Noetherian semilocal G-ring. Here semilocal means having only finitely many maximal ideals. For any such $\gamma\subseteq\delta$, the canonical transition map $D_\delta\to D_\gamma$ is regular, meaning flat with Noetherian geometrically regular residue-field fibres [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: Kurano–Shimomoto, Appendix A, Definition A.1(2), printed p.14, and the G-ring local lifting assertion on printed p.15 (the given ring is semilocal, not necessarily local); §2, printed p.2, semilocal G-rings are quasi-excellent and hence Nagata. Transition comparison as in (5.8), printed p.12, with an arbitrary retained finite set of maximal ideals.
